scripts.ios: echo 'iOS is not supported in this project.' && exit 1
scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output build/index.android.bundle --assets-dest build
scripts.build:ios: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace SunmiPrinterLibraryExample.xcworkspace -scheme SunmiPrinterLibraryExample -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator CC=clang CPLUSPLUS=clang++ LD=clang LDPLUSPLUS=clang++ GCC_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=0 GCC_PRECOMPILE_PREFIX_HEADER=YES ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_OPTIMIZATION=time DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT=dwarf COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO
